name: ZeroNote
description: ZeroNote is an open-source, offline-first unified app that replaces your password manager, bookmark manager, notes app, and 2FA authenticator with a single encrypted note-taking system powered by smart tags, where everything is stored locally on your device with zero-knowledge encryption and optional peer-to-peer or S3 sync.
short_desc: All your notes, passwords, bookmarks, and 2FA in one secure, offline-first app
author: besoeasy

form_fields.label: Container User (UID:GID)
form_fields.hint: Process user and group ID (UID:GID). Keep 1000:1000 unless custom host permissions are required.
form_fields.pattern_error: Must be a numeric UID:GID (e.g. 1000:1000) or numeric UID (e.g. 1000)
